name: placeholder
comment: Integers only. Distances in px, angles in Angle units (4096 per turn, positive turns +X toward +Y), speeds in px/1000 per frame. Values from reference/frame-data-baseline; 1 SF4 unit = 167 px (jump apex matched to our 294 px height).

stats.comment-throws: Throw range is feet to feet. After a throw connects, the thrown animation plays techFrame frames, then the game looks back techWindow frames for LP+LK (SF4: 7 and 12). A tech breaks both apart by techSeparation each. A completed throw lands the opponent throwDistance away (in front, or behind for a back throw) and knocks them down for knockdownFrames; the thrower is free throwFollowThrough frames after the tech check. Waking up gives wakeupThrowInvulnerable frames of throw invulnerability.
stats.comment-dashes: Dashes, from 66 and 44 with the second tap within dashInputWindow frames of the first. forwardDashFrames and backDashFrames (SF4: 18 and 27) are the whole dash; the last forwardDashRecovery / backDashRecovery of them stand still, and before that the fighter covers the distance (px) on a curve that starts fast and eases to a stop. The back-dash's first backDashInvincibleFrames have no hurtboxes and can't be thrown. Distances, recoveries and the window are placeholders for the playtest.
stats.comment-hit-states: crouchHitstunBonus: extra hitstun frames on a crouching defender (SF4 gives crouchers a little more). lowLifeReduction: SF4's damage reduction for a defender under 50% (x0.95), 30% (x0.90) and 15% (x0.75) health. An air hit knocks the defender into a fall: airHitRise (up, at the hit) and airHitDrift (away from the attacker, each frame), px/1000 per frame; gravity brings them down. Placeholders for the playtest.
stats.comment-knockdowns: Knockdowns: knockdownFrames is SF4's face-up wakeup (31), for throws, sweeps (hard: no quick rise) and juggle landings (soft). A quick rise (down, or two attack buttons, pressed within quickRiseWindow frames before landing from a juggle) gets up after quickRiseFrames instead. Stun: each hit adds its scaled stun to the gauge; at the character's stun (1000) the fighter, once out of hitstun, is dizzy for dizzyFrames and the gauge resets. The gauge recovers stunRecoveryRate a frame once stunRecoveryDelay frames have passed since the last hit, and resets on a knockdown (unless full: then the fighter gets up dizzy). quickRiseFrames, dizzyFrames and the recovery numbers aren't sourced: placeholders for the playtest.

comment-stats: crouchTransitionFrames: frames from standing to the crouch pose, counting as crouching throughout (SF4's figure). pushShare: walking into a fighter who isn't walking in, how much of the walker's step moves them along, per mille; the walker keeps the same share, so the pair moves together at that fraction of walking speed. pushHeight here is the standing pushbox; a pose may set its own. The jump arc: jumpVelocity (up, at takeoff) and gravity (each frame) in px/1000, chosen so it lands in exactly airborneFrames (the loader checks) with its apex at 294 px, SF4's 1.76 units; jumpForward and jumpBack are the sideways drift (placeholders for the playtest).

skeleton.comment: Bone lengths and capsule radii. Hip is the root; arms hang from the neck, legs from the hip.

poses.comment: Keyed poses that hold until the next key. Angles are local: spine from straight up, neck from the spine, shoulders from straight down the spine, hips from straight down (so leaning keeps the feet planted), elbows and knees from their parent bone. Guard hands stay within 16 px of the centre line, so two fighters at minimum distance (pushboxes touching) never cross arms.

dizzy.comment: Swaying on the spot, arms hanging, head lolling: a 40-frame loop. It sways back and upright, never forward, so heads don't meet at point-blank.

knockdown.comment: Lying on the back, head behind, knees up a little. The pushbox is as low as the body.

crouchDown.comment: Standing to crouching: as long as stats.crouchTransitionFrames, still tall (standing pushbox), but counting as crouching for blocking and crouching normals.

preJump.comment: Crouching to spring, for stats.preJumpFrames: on the ground, feet planted.

jump.comment: In the air: the tuck the jumping normals start from (jump-tuck in data/moves/library.json). The origin is where the feet would be, so the legs fold up above it.

landing.comment: Touching down, for stats.landingFrames: the same squat as preJump.

dashForward.comment: Placeholder: the forward walk's long stride, held for the dash.

dashBack.comment: Placeholder: the back walk's long stride, leaning away, held for the dash.

comment-moves: Moves live in placeholder.moves.json, compiled from the scripts in data/moves/placeholder/ by tools/MoveCompiler.
